reason: (1) sanitize_markdown_link returns f'[{label}]({url})' unconditionally and never calls is_safe_url, so unsafe URLs such as javascript: are still emitted as links, violating Req 2. (2) is_safe_url uses url.lower().startswith(s) on raw input, which does not parse the scheme: 'https' matches 'httpsx:' and 'http' matches 'httpfoo', it has no data: rejection, and it does not reject whitespace/control characters (e.g. 'java\tscript:' or leading '\x00'). (3) The only new test, test_unsafe_url_fallback, passes only because the bare 'javascript:' string fails the prefix check, and it does not exercise the fallback path (the function never checks safety). Required tests for is_safe_url and the data:/control-char cases are missing.
target_issue: T05 Req 1 (is_safe_url rejects javascript:, data:, control/whitespace chars, and out-of-allowlist schemes) and T05 Req 2 (sanitize_markdown_link must return clean plain label for unsafe URLs); test_unsafe_url_fallback passes only by accident and no test covers Req 1 cases
